exchange-rate.def: The price of one currency in units of another, such as 1.25 dollars per euro. The same rate written the other way is its reciprocal: 0.80 euro per dollar.

appreciation.def: A rise in the value of a currency: one unit buys more of another currency than before. Its opposite, depreciation, is a fall in value; when one currency appreciates against another, the other depreciates.
